parts.visual:
A brilliant engineer builds the perfect app. They put it on the App Store. Nobody downloads it. They go bankrupt.

The Mistake:
1. 'If you build it, they will come' is the biggest lie in Silicon Valley.
2. Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy: A tactical action plan that outlines exactly how you will reach your target customers and achieve a competitive advantage. Will you use massive Facebook ads? Direct B2B sales teams? Viral TikTok marketing?
parts.audio: A Go-to-Market strategy is your invasion plan. Investors do not just invest in great products; they invest in founders who know exactly how to distribute that product to millions of people.

questions.question: A founder pitching a $500,000 enterprise software product tells the VC: 'Our Go-to-Market strategy is to run Instagram ads and hope CEOs click on them.' Why will the VC immediately reject this?
options: Channel Mismatch. You cannot sell a $500,000 complex B2B product via a casual social media ad. You need a dedicated, highly trained direct outbound sales team.
questions.correct_answer: Channel Mismatch. You cannot sell a $500,000 complex B2B product via a casual social media ad. You need a dedicated, highly trained direct outbound sales team.
questions.explanation: Your distribution channel must mathematically and psychologically match your price point.

questions.question: Listen to the growth hacker's strategy. What kind of GTM are they using?
questions.tts_text: We are not hiring any salespeople. We are building a referral loop directly into the app. When a user invites three friends, they get premium features for free. The product will distribute itself.
options: Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Viral Loops. The product itself acts as the primary driver of customer acquisition, drastically lowering marketing costs.
questions.correct_answer: Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Viral Loops. The product itself acts as the primary driver of customer acquisition, drastically lowering marketing costs.
questions.explanation: This is how Dropbox, Slack, and Zoom acquired their first 100 million users.

questions.question: What is the danger of relying on 'SEO' (Search Engine Optimization) as your ONLY Go-to-Market strategy on Day 1?
options: It takes 6 to 12 months for Google to rank your website. A startup only has a few months of cash. You will literally run out of money before your SEO starts working.
questions.correct_answer: It takes 6 to 12 months for Google to rank your website. A startup only has a few months of cash. You will literally run out of money before your SEO starts working.
questions.explanation: SEO is a great long-term strategy, but startups need short-term 'hacks' to survive the first year.

questions.question: Why do elite founders focus on finding 'One channel that works' instead of trying ten channels at once?
options: Startups have zero resources. If you put 10% of your energy into 10 channels, they will all fail. You must find the ONE channel that yields results and pour 100% of your money into it until it breaks.
questions.correct_answer: Startups have zero resources. If you put 10% of your energy into 10 channels, they will all fail. You must find the ONE channel that yields results and pour 100% of your money into it until it breaks.
questions.explanation: Focus is a startup's only weapon against giant corporations.

pairs.match: An action plan that specifies how a company will reach target customers and achieve a competitive advantage
A strategy where the product itself is the primary driver of acquisition, retention, and expansion
A traditional method where sales reps actively reach out to potential customers
A mechanism that encourages users to invite others to use the product
